subtitle: Lesson 6 · An Arrow-native, multi-threaded engine

code:
lazy = (df.lazy()
    .filter(pl.col("price") > 200)
    .select(["ticker", "price"]))
lazy.explain()   # plan, nothing ran
lazy.collect()   # now it runs
caption: A LazyFrame builds a plan the optimizer can rewrite before execution.
select, filter, with_columns, group_by().agg() cover almost everything.
